title: How a Checked Bag's Weight Is Counted at Each Check-In Point
content:
**Airport services weighing convention — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** For a weight or size charge, the bag concerned is the heaviest bag carrying a first, second or third bag charge on the ticket's first unflown segment; its tag, recorded weight and check-in channel are read from its bag charge. The **weight counted** is set by one of three conventions by where the bag was checked:

| Where the bag was checked | Weight counted |
|---|---|
| At the airport counter | Its recorded weight less the scale tolerance of 3 pounds |
| Online | Its declared weight, as recorded, rounded up to the next multiple of five pounds; a weight already a multiple of five stays as it is |
| Through the call center | Its recorded weight |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

| Channel on the bag charge | Recorded weight (lb) | Weight counted (lb) |
|---|---|---|
| Airport | 52 | 49 |
| Airport | 53 | 50 |
| Online | 51 | 55 |
| Online | 55 | 55 |
| Call center | 52 | 52 |

When two bags with a bag charge on the segment are recorded at 58 lb and 46 lb, the 58 lb bag is the one concerned.
